theme: Telomere protection, capping and telomerase-based maintenance
core_role: The shared pathways are about protecting and capping telomere ends and suppressing recombination-based (ATRX/DAXX-restrained ALT) lengthening, the protective counterpart to the telomerase recruitment and extension machinery in the additional set.

theme: Meiotic prophase I recombination in gametogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the core meiosis I machinery (programmed DSB formation, synapsis, recombination and its checkpoint) framed as the chromosomal engine of male and female gamete formation.

theme: Microglial response to amyloid-beta in Alzheimer's disease
core_role: The shared pathways frame glial activation and amyloid/tau pathology as the neuroinflammatory microglial response to amyloid, which the additional set ties to phagocytic and lysosomal clearance.

theme: B cell activation and plasma cell differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are B-cell identity and memory signatures, framed as the activated B-lineage pool that differentiates into immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells.

theme: Basement membrane and collagen extracellular matrix assembly
core_role: The shared pathways are about cell-matrix adhesion and basement membrane architecture (laminin, integrins, hemidesmosomes, anchoring fibrils), framed as anchoring tissue to a collagen and elastic fibre matrix.

theme: Nephron development from intermediate mesoderm
core_role: The shared pathways are about metanephric mesenchyme differentiation, mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition and nephron patterning, framed as nephrogenesis alongside ureteric bud growth and progenitor survival.

theme: ER membrane shaping and lipid transfer at contact sites
core_role: The shared pathways are about non-vesicular phospholipid (PI/PC) transfer at ER contact sites and ER tubule shaping, framed as organization of the ER tubular network.

theme: Xenobiotic and toxin biotransformation (phase I/II detoxification)
core_role: The shared pathways are phase I oxidation by cytochromes P450 and phase II conjugation (sulfonation, methylation, acetylation), framed as detoxifying drugs, dietary compounds and toxins.

theme: Urea cycle and ammonia detoxification disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are urea cycle metabolism of ornithine, citrulline and arginine and its inborn errors, framed as nitrogen disposal and ammonia homeostasis.

theme: Notch receptor proteolytic activation and oncogenic signaling
core_role: The shared pathways are NOTCH1/2 activation, including constitutively active cancer mutants, framed as cleavage-dependent signal transmission to the nucleus driven by regulated intramembrane proteolysis.

theme: tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation for translation
core_role: The shared pathways are tRNA charging, wobble modification and splicing, framed as ensuring decoding fidelity in cytosolic and mitochondrial translation.

theme: PAX3/AP-2 transcriptional control of cadherin expression
core_role: The shared pathways are PAX3 targets and transcriptional regulation of cadherin genes (CDH1, CDH11, CDH19), framed as neural-crest-type transcription factors switching cell adhesion programs.

theme: Reactive carbonyl detoxification and damage repair
core_role: The shared pathways are methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and repair of glycated proteins (DJ-1/glyoxalase-type), framed as protecting macromolecules from reactive metabolic by-products.

theme: Rodent behavioral phenotypes: sensorimotor, social and motor
core_role: The shared pathways are behavioral readouts (exploration, prepulse inhibition, grooming, social interaction) with MECP2 links, framed as neurodevelopmental behavioral phenotypes that extend into motor coordination.

theme: Mitotic and meiotic chromosome segregation and division
core_role: The shared pathways are the mitotic machinery (spindle, kinetochore, cohesion, condensation, cytokinesis), framed as the general chromosome-segregation core that meiotic division adapts.

theme: Myelination and axon regeneration in CNS and PNS
core_role: The shared pathways are myelin formation and maintenance by Schwann cells and oligodendrocytes plus axon regrowth after injury, framed as glia-axon interactions governing nerve integrity and repair.

theme: Microtubule-based axonal organelle transport in neurons
core_role: The shared pathways are kinesin-driven axonal transport of mitochondria, synaptic vesicles and endolysosomes, framed as maintaining motor neuron survival through microtubule-dependent trafficking.

theme: SLC anion transporters in mineralization and acid-base disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are inorganic anion transport (bicarbonate, sulfate, phosphate, iodide, oxalate) and its transporter diseases, framed as ion handling that governs tissue mineralization and acid-base balance.

theme: Immediate-early stimulus response converging on AP-1
core_role: The shared pathways are broad stimulus-responsive signaling (PI3K/mTOR, TNF/NF-kB, p38, NR4A), framed as immediate-early gene induction converging on AP-1 transcription.

theme: Base excision repair of damaged DNA bases
core_role: The shared pathways are AP-site processing, gap-filling and glycosylase defects, framed as the downstream repair steps of BER that follow lesion recognition and base cleavage.

theme: Amino acid catabolism and cofactor-dependent metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are amino acid catabolism (aromatic, histidine, proline, threonine, glycine) and its disorders, framed within a cofactor-dependent (BH4, vitamin B6) network extending to sulfur amino acids.

theme: Non-vesicular lipid transfer between membranes
core_role: The shared pathways are phospholipid (PI/PC) transfer between membranes, framed as one branch of lipid transfer-protein activity alongside glycolipid and ceramide transport.

theme: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT
core_role: The shared pathways are IRS/PI3K/AKT signaling downstream of insulin/IGF1 receptors, framed as the effector arm of receptor tyrosine kinase signaling that also feeds ERK.

theme: Excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic assembly
core_role: The shared pathways are GABAergic and glutamatergic postsynaptic clustering and excitation-inhibition balance, framed as neurexin-neuroligin-organized synapse formation.

theme: RNA and translation-factor modification for translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways are tRNA/rRNA modifications and aminoacylation, framed as maintaining translational fidelity, extended to modification of translation factors (hypusine, diphthamide).

theme: Visual retinoid cycle and retinal degeneration
core_role: The shared pathways are the rod and cone retinoid cycle and its enzyme defects, framed as chromophore regeneration that sustains phototransduction.

theme: Complement activation and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are classical and alternative complement activation and its regulators, framed as a humoral innate immune effector leading to C3/C5 activation and opsonization.

theme: Base excision repair lesion recognition and cleavage
core_role: The shared pathways are DNA glycosylase recognition and excision of damaged bases and AP-site handling, framed as the initiating steps of base excision repair before gap filling.

theme: Stress, arousal and sleep-wake behavior
core_role: The shared pathways are neuroendocrine stress (CRH, corticosterone) and orexin-driven arousal behaviors, framed as regulation of arousal state across the sleep-wake cycle.

theme: T cell suppression and regulatory T cell tolerance
core_role: The shared pathways are negative regulation of T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine production plus Treg induction, framed as immunoregulatory tolerance.

theme: Cytochrome P450 xenobiotic and steroid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are P450-mediated oxidation and conjugation of xenobiotics and steroids, framed as hepatic detoxification of foreign and endogenous small molecules.

theme: Chondrocyte differentiation and endochondral ossification
core_role: The shared pathways are chondrocyte condensation, proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy in the growth plate, framed as endochondral bone formation within skeletal morphogenesis.

theme: ERBB family receptor signaling
core_role: The shared pathways are EGFR/ERBB2 adaptor-mediated downstream signaling, framed as the canonical core of signaling across the whole ERBB receptor family.

theme: Endosomal TLR7/8/9 nucleic-acid sensing
core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of TLR7/8/9 and SLC15A4-TASL-IRF5 activation, framed as endosomal nucleic-acid sensing relevant to autoimmunity.

theme: Blood pressure regulation by renin-angiotensin and vascular tone
core_role: The shared pathways are renin-angiotensin, endothelin, natriuresis and vasoconstriction control, framed as systemic arterial pressure homeostasis acting via vascular smooth muscle.

theme: Macrophage cholesterol efflux, HDL and foam cells
core_role: The shared pathways are LXR/ABCA1-driven cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly and foam cell regulation, framed as the cellular start of reverse cholesterol transport and lipoprotein remodeling.

theme: Gonadal development and gonadotropin-driven reproductive function
core_role: The shared pathways are germ cell and ovarian/testicular processes (ovulation, luteinization, Sertoli proliferation), framed as gonadal functions driven by gonadotropin signaling.

theme: Myeloid chemotaxis via formyl peptide and chemokine receptors
core_role: The shared pathways are GPCR-mediated chemoattraction of neutrophils, monocytes and macrophages, framed as recruitment of innate cellular defense.

theme: Axon guidance by SLIT/ROBO, netrin and ephrin
core_role: The shared pathways are guidance-cue receptor signaling to Rho family GTPases, framed as attractive and repulsive axon pathfinding including midline crossing.

theme: Nucleotide sugar and sialic acid metabolism in glycosylation disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are synthesis and Golgi transport of nucleotide sugars (UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid) and their defects, framed as substrate supply for glycosylation in congenital glycosylation disorders.

theme: IL-10 and IL-12 family cytokine signaling
core_role: The shared pathways are IL-10, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-20 family signaling, framed as JAK-STAT cytokines balancing inflammation alongside type III interferon and wound repair.

theme: Rho family GTPase cycles and cytoskeletal signaling
core_role: The shared pathways are Rho GTPase cycles and effectors (formins, IQGAPs), framed as cytoskeleton and adhesion control downstream of G12/13 and semaphorin-plexin activation.

theme: Bacterial lipid sensing by TLR2/TLR4 in monocytes
core_role: The shared pathways are LPS and lipopeptide detection through TLR4/CD14 and TLR2, framed as innate inflammatory activation of monocytes and myeloid cells.

theme: Sulfur amino acid and selenium metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are transsulfuration, cysteine catabolism and sulfide oxidation with their B6 and molybdenum cofactors, framed as chalcogen metabolism parallel to selenium processing.

theme: Endosome-Golgi retrograde and lysosomal trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways are endosome-to-TGN retrograde transport and Golgi-to-lysosome sorting, framed as vesicular cargo sorting that maintains organelle identity and lysosomal hydrolase delivery.

theme: IL-6/STAT3 and ERK signaling with phosphatase feedback
core_role: The shared pathways are IL-6 signaling and ERK activation and its negative feedback, framed as phosphorylation-driven signaling terminated by dephosphorylation.

theme: Innate social, reproductive and emotional behaviors
core_role: The shared pathways are behavioral phenotypes (mating, parental, aggressive, exploratory), framed as innate behaviors modulated by stress and arousal neuroendocrine signaling.

theme: DNA replication initiation and G1/S transition
core_role: The shared pathways are replication origin licensing and firing and the E2F program, framed as S-phase entry monitored by replication stress checkpoints.

theme: FGFR downstream signaling via PI3K and PLC-gamma
core_role: The shared pathways are the PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades of FGFR1-4, framed as the downstream effector branches of FGF receptor signaling, including mutant FGFRs.

theme: TNFR1 and NF-kB signaling via linear ubiquitination
core_role: The shared pathways are TNFR1-driven NF-kB regulation by linear polyubiquitination, framed as inflammatory transcription-factor control shared with IRAK1-IKK signaling from TLRs.
